c-admin-plugin-pages.2.evidence: Browser walk of 31 admin URLs (all 11 Settings tabs, all 5 Moderation tabs, Content and the rest): 0 responses >= 400 and 0 console errors; every panel loaded.

c-admin-plugin-pages.16.evidence: Midnight admin colour scheme + prefers-color-scheme dark on the Dashboard: 14 raw white panels remain (jetonomy-stat-card, dashboard cards, widefat table) on a #f0f0f0 body. The plugin ships no dark admin treatment (assets/css/admin.css unchanged since the first walk); WordPress core's own content area is light in every admin scheme, so the runbook expectation may need rewording.
